title: Siege of Bautzen (1620)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Bautzen (1620)", at revision 1370739355, opens: "The Capture of Bautzen occurred in September 1620, during the later stages of the Bohemian Revolt, when the Saxons bombarded the fortress city of Bautzen. The capture was a major victory for the Saxons, and the Bohemians withdrew to their last fortress in Lusatia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q136351768, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of the Thirty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
